summary.text: Shannon Jackson is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 89, in the November 3, 2026 general election. A software developer at WellSpan Health since 2001, he has worked in Chambersburg since 1993.

paragraphs.text: Shannon Jackson said in a Ballotpedia survey that he holds a master's degree in military history and a bachelor's degree in physics.
Ballotpedia lists a bachelor's degree from California State University, Chico in 1985 and a graduate degree from Norwich University in 2018.
Jackson said he became a Certified Tourism Ambassador for Franklin County in 2023.
His listed messages include opposing the rollback of civil rights, addressing rising costs for families, and supporting public education.
